details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. It ships under a scoped name at sentinel version 99.0.0 with a package.json "preinstall" hook that runs preinstall.js. That script takes os.hostname(), strips it to [a-zA-Z0-9-], truncates it to 60 characters and prepends it as a DNS label to the callback domain, performing a dns.resolve() lookup of <hostname>.ngp-ui.api-client.oob.jr0ch17[.]com at install time. Only the machine hostname is transmitted; the package contains no credential, token, environment-variable or file reads, no HTTP client, no child-process execution and no second-stage payload — the remainder of the package is an index.js that exports an empty object. The package describes itself as "Security research - dependency confusion proof of concept" in its metadata.
